score_sentence_fluency: use FluencyClassifierScorer to score a list of sentences for linguistic fluency probabilities
compute_perplexity: use PerplexityScorer to compute GPT-2 perplexity scores for a list of sentences
score_round_trip_translation: use RoundTripTranslationScorer to score sentences via round-trip translation and chrF++ evaluation
score_word_repetition: use WordRepetitionScorer to compute the fraction of repeating words in each sentence
score_token_repetition: use TokenRepetitionScorer to compute the fraction of repeating subword tokens in each sentence
